rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard application of the SPR-KKR code with published parameters for simple rock-salt structures. No derivation or novel algorithm implementation is required.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves multiple steps: preparing crystal structure inputs, running SCF loops, computing directional Compton profiles, spherical averaging, adding free-atom core contributions, extracting band gaps, and generating EVED profiles. It requires familiarity with the SPR-KKR input/output format and post-processing, constituting a multi-stage pipeline with dependencies.
